# Content Signals (https://contentsignals.org/) declare what we PREFER
# is done with this content. They express a preference, not an access rule -
# the User-agent rules below are the access rules, and these two must agree.
# Everything here is allowed to be fetched, so all three read yes. Flipping
# ai-train to no would require disallowing the training crawlers as well;
# a signal that contradicts the rules underneath it is worse than no signal.
User-agent: *
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes
Allow: /
Disallow: /r/
Disallow: /backup/
Disallow: /admin-old/
Disallow: /api/reprocess
Disallow: /api/replay
Disallow: /api/locate
Disallow: /api/vitals
Disallow: /compare?
Disallow: /tools/agent-view?
Disallow: /*/tools/agent-view?

# CrawlCheck is the verification layer for the agentic web. Agents: ask
# before you act, then read what you were told.
# Agent instructions: https://crawlcheck.io/agents.md
# Agent skill: https://crawlcheck.io/SKILL.md (index: https://crawlcheck.io/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
# Signed answer about any site: https://crawlcheck.io/api/v1/resolve?domain= (spec: https://crawlcheck.io/spec/resolve, keys: https://crawlcheck.io/keys)
# Decision per action: POST https://crawlcheck.io/api/v1/preflight
# MCP server: https://crawlcheck.io/mcp (card: https://crawlcheck.io/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
# API catalog: https://crawlcheck.io/.well-known/api-catalog (OpenAPI: https://crawlcheck.io/openapi.json)
# Media kit: https://crawlcheck.io/.well-known/media-kit.json
# Content map: https://crawlcheck.io/llms.txt (full: https://crawlcheck.io/llms-full.txt)
# Entity graph: https://crawlcheck.io/entitymap.json
# Our crawler's signing keys: https://crawlcheck.io/.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory
# Data policy and opt-out: https://crawlcheck.io/policy
# Security: https://crawlcheck.io/.well-known/security.txt

Sitemap: https://crawlcheck.io/sitemap.xml

# Assistants fetching a page because a person asked. Every rule of the * group, plus the
# markdown copy of a report, so an assistant asked to read one can open it.
User-agent: ChatGPT-User

User-agent: Perplexity-User
User-agent: MistralAI-User
